description: Improve backtest data loading error reporting and path resolution. Print actual exception and absolute path being tried. Try path as-is, then with .csv extension, then relative to config directory.
steps: Modify backtester.py load_data() to return detailed error info (exception message, paths tried)
In backtester.py load_data(), try the path as-is first, then with .csv appended, then relative to the script directory
Print the absolute path being tried during load attempts
Modify main.py run_backtest() to print detailed error info when load_data fails
acceptance_criteria: load_data prints the actual exception when pd.read_csv fails
load_data tries the path as-is, then with .csv extension appended, then relative to config/script directory
load_data prints the absolute path it is attempting to load
run_backtest in main.py shows useful debugging info (path tried, exception) on failure
findings: Implemented multi-path resolution in backtester.py load_data(). The method now tries 6 path candidates (original, +.csv, config-dir relative, config-dir +.csv, project-root relative, project-root +.csv) and prints the absolute path for each attempt. On failure it prints the actual exception. main.py run_backtest() now passes the config directory and prints detailed diagnostics including all errors and a hint about supported formats. All 114 existing tests pass unchanged.
